entities.summary: Muhammad Baqir Yazdi Persian: محمدباقر یزدی was an Iranian mathematician who lived in the 16th century. He gave the pair of amicable numbers 9,363,584 and 9,437,056 many years before Euler's contribution to amicable numbers. His major book is Oyoun Alhesab.
